contract.target: Windows PC, Korean child jamo recognition, Unity GPUCompute

acceptance.korean_jamo: Same speaker-disjoint Korean child pilot, explicit JER and limits
acceptance.gpu_backend: Actual Unity GPUCompute inference; CPU-only inference is not sufficient
acceptance.latency: Warm p95 < 500ms for the existing hop; main-thread/frame impact reported separately
acceptance.parity: Full logit/numeric comparison and CTC token agreement on same inputs
acceptance.deployment: Windows standalone smoke when feasible; editor results labeled separately

contract.heads: frozen encoder + same linear CTC initial screen; not full-finetune ranking

notes: No production model/runtime/package was replaced by this harness
Frozen-probe and short fine-tuning scores are not convergence rankings
Derived transcript labels do not validate pronunciation-error diagnoses

normalization_decision.reason: Native mean channel standard deviations differed by >20x. Added equal-budget scalar normalization candidates with validation-only selection against raw features. Per-channel centering/scaling changed relative channel weighting and hurt HuBERT validation; preserved separately and excluded from the principal protocol.
normalization_decision.scope: Train-only statistics; same four settings per model (identity/scalar x LR0.001/0.003); test and owned words not used to choose the setting.
normalization_decision.runtime_note: Raw-head Unity import and player results remain architecture evidence. Trained finalists get a new complete waveform-to-logit export.

second_seed_selection.rule: Smallest valid JER among completed seed917 pilots, not test or owned words

selected_probe.rule: minimum valid JER over raw/scalar x two learning rates
